Completed decisions do not infer completed/cancelled targets or media custody.

Reconciliation accepts only completed/cancelled/failed plus an evidence ID. Host verifies attributed evidence, current authority and worker/target revision. No evidence-issuance API or caller-outcome authority is introduced.
